comparator.name: Computational Social Science
comparator.sourceNotes: The official current study-programme page publishes five required 30-EC semester modules plus 30 EC of genuine fifth-semester choice, for 180 ECTS in total. The first four modules integrate social-science, digital, research and change-making expertise around climate/surveillance, behavioural interventions, health/mobility and responsible AI/inequality. The final semester is a 30-EC capstone with an external organisation.

components.name: Foundation: Appreciating the complexity of social challenges
Building blocks: Experimenting with digital interventions of behavioural change
Connections: Linking data for better interventions in health or mobility systems
Structures: Applying responsible AI to reduce inequality
Minor, electives, internship or study abroad
components.note: Genuine fifth-semester choice space; no specific option is invented.

components.name: Capstone: Making social change with digital innovations

alternativeSelection.assessment: The closest match owns the programme-defining integration of computation, social research, public problem solving and responsible intervention. Climate/mobility data and responsible AI/inequality are the two strongest coherent remaining directions and yield feasible, substantively distinct curricula. Health systems and technology is also coherent but cannot be added after the three-alternative maximum is reached.

comparisonAlignment.rationale: Both establish beginner programming and computational problem-solving foundations.
Both apply machine learning while requiring critical reflection on model decisions and effects.
Both use qualitative social research to understand stakeholders and complex systems.
Both turn communication and design ideas into an applied prototype or intervention.
Both culminate in advanced, applied research addressing a complex public challenge.
No single selected UCR course is presented as a direct counterpart to Minor, electives, internship or study abroad.

notes.text: UvA integrates social, digital, research and change-making expertise inside 30-EC semester projects with external partners. UCR distributes related study across 24 separately credited Liberal Arts and Sciences courses.
The fifth semester is published as 30 EC of minor, electives, internship or study abroad. That genuine choice space is preserved as an aggregate rather than populated with an invented option.
